segments.text: Have you ever received exactly what you needed, from a direction you never thought to look?
One of the names of Allah is ar-Razzaq, the Provider. Nothing that breathes keeps itself alive on its own.
The bird does not plant the field it eats from. Yet every morning, the earth wakes, and is fed.
There is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision.
segments.arabicText: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا

segments.text: And your provision is not only food. It is calm when you were anxious, a door when every wall felt closed.
And He will provide for him from where he does not expect.
So loosen your grip on the how. The Provider was never limited to the paths you can see. He is ar-Razzaq. What is written for you will reach you, even through a door you cannot see.
